source_skill: Translate a linear combination of three R^3 vectors into three scalar equations, solve by Gaussian elimination/back substitution or identify inconsistency, then evaluate the requested signed sum of coefficients.
canonical: Replay only, no invented answer bank
math: Moderate nonsingular 3x3 systems and hard inconsistent systems preserve source difficulty division. Three fixed vectors in R^3; component equations, elimination/back substitution and target signed sum; no added operators or learner input requirements.
new_bank_extension: Translations reanchor the existing complete bank and preserve numeric/text composition and gap profile. No new prerequisite or reasoning stage. Distractor values change without adding solution workload.
fixed_target_reasoning: Profiles conservatively retain their demonstrated scalar expression; source signed sum is present. Broader signed targets are defensible but not necessary to repair bank rank; preserving these expressions does not expose a fixed correct rank. No broader target-mastery claim.
unsupported: Easy absent; consistent singular systems requiring an undetermined target not evidenced. No supported source family omitted.
